cast.speaker: Chantelle M
cast.description: Female voice in her early 20s, thick Essex accent, loud, bubbly, wildly overconfident hustle-culture girlboss who believes every get-rich-quick scheme, talking on the phone while walking outside, excited, giggly, breathless with joy.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Chantelle M
dialogue_lines.text: <excited> Babes! Don't worry! I've found a new side hustle!
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: Babes! Don't worry! I've found a new side hustle!

dialogue_lines.speaker: Chantelle M
dialogue_lines.text: <excited> I found out... I can sell my breast milk.
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: I found out... I can sell my breast milk.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Chantelle M
dialogue_lines.text: <angry> No! No, no, no! This is not like last time!
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: No! No, no, no! This is not like last time!

dialogue_lines.speaker: Chantelle M
dialogue_lines.text: <excited> The lash thing was a learning experience! The crypto was a learning experience! This is the one, Karen, I can feel it. I've been manifesting!
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: The lash thing was a learning experience! The crypto was a learning experience! This is the one, Karen, I can feel it. I've been manifesting!

dialogue_lines.speaker: Chantelle M
dialogue_lines.text: <whisper> Okay, yes. It's behind a Tesco. But he's legit!
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: Okay, yes. It's behind a Tesco. But he's legit!

dialogue_lines.speaker: Chantelle M
dialogue_lines.text: <sigh> He said I've got serious supplier potential. Nobody's ever said that to me before, Karen. Not even my own mum.
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: He said I've got serious supplier potential. Nobody's ever said that to me before, Karen. Not even my own mum.

dialogue_lines.speaker: Chantelle M
dialogue_lines.text: <cry> When I'm on the cover of Forbes, don't come crying to me. You just don't want me to succeed.
dialogue_lines.clean_subtitle_text: When I'm on the cover of Forbes, don't come crying to me. You just don't want me to succeed.
